title: Valid API Call for Getting All Products
preconditions: API is up and running, the endpoint is accessible
steps: Send a GET request to https://qa.abcorp.com/v1/getAllProducts
expectedResult: Status code 200 and valid response from API containing product data

title: Invalid API Call for Getting All Products
preconditions: API is up and running, the endpoint is accessible
steps: Send an incorrect request method (e.g., POST or DELETE) to https://qa.abcorp.com/v1/getAllProducts
expectedResult: Status code other than 200 and an error response from API
